en: So, what else do you like to do when you have time? Do you have a hobby you're into?
A hobby? Well, let's see...
Come on, there must be some sort of thing you like to do.
It's just that I have so many! I can't pick just one.
That sounds pretty fulfilling, having so many hobbies like that. If you talk about them often enough, they might even get you some TV commercials!
Take me for example. I always talk about how much I like sake. So I finally got offered a commercial, and was it for sake? No. It was for hangover medicine!
What's the name of the medicine?
Now, now. You're the guest here. You don't have to worry about plugging my sponsor. That's my job!
Work is pretty much my hobby, I guess. It's just so much fun! I really love it.
Well, aren't you the diligent one! And at such a young age, too. But you really should have other hobbies, you know. And you should tell people all about them!
Because the more people you tell, the greater the chance you'll get offered TV commercials!
What's your hobby, Nomu-san?
You're answering my question with a question? We're here to talk about you!
Besides, the audience doesn't wanna hear any more about my hobby. Right, folks?
Ooh-wee, you're clapping for that!? I guess you <Italic>really</Italic> don't wanna hear any more about me, huh?
Well, if you were of legal drinking age, we could talk about sake.
Ooh, how good would a cup of sake taste if you were the one who poured it! You're that cute, I'm telling ya!
My goodness!
You're so cute, Haruka-chan!
You really are adorable.
What, no response?
Now, where were we? Oh right, we were talking about you pouring me drinks.
But if you were the one who was pouring, I bet I'd end up drinking way too much!
You're still too young, so you've never had a hangover, right?
Hangovers at my age are especially rough. That's why before I drink, I always have some of that stuff.... Hmm, what was it again?
Darn. I just can't seem to remember. And you're no help either, Haruka-chan!
This may be your second time on the show, but we still don't click at all, do we?
Milk?
Hmm. I have heard people say milk coats your stomach and keeps you from getting too drunk.
But apparently that isn't true. Other people say milk doesn't really coat your stomach at all.
Oh, I didn't know that.
Hey, but that's why I recommend the hangover medicine, "Before You Drink"!
It works wonders, I tell ya!
Turmeric?
Yeah, I've heard turmeric can be helpful. But that's not what I was talking about.
Oh, now I remember!
The hangover medicine from those TV commercials I'm on, "Before You Drink"! It works wonders, I tell ya!
Bloody something-or-other?
Now wait just a minute, Haruka-chan! Are you trying to curse on TV?
What kind of language is that for a nice, young girl like you to use? You should apologize to our viewers!
I'm sorry! I wasn't trying to curse! I was trying to remember the name of a drink!
Oh, you mean a Bloody Mary? Hair of the dog, and all that? Nah, that won't work! It'll just dehydrate you even more!
Well, folks. It looks like we're just about out of time for today. Thanks for our chat, Haruka-chan!
And now comes everybody's favorite part! It's time for the smile vote!
This time, if you get 75 smiles or more, I'll give you an exclusive Nomu-san cell phone strap!
I did pretty well today, don't you think? I tried my absolute best, so I hope you'll vote for me!
Hey, I tried my absolute best today, too!
Thank you for the support, everyone! I hope you vote for me!
Isn't she cute? I hope you all vote for her, too!
This has been so much fun! I really enjoyed spending time with all of you! I hope you vote for me!
Wow! Would you look at that! Isn't that great?
Congratulations, Haruka-chan, you win the Nomu-san strap!
This is your third time on the show, isn't it? I bet you're getting used to it by now.
No, I'm still really nervous.
Aww, you don't have to be so humble.
Anyway. Today, we thought we'd have you talk a little bit about what it's really like to be an idol.
Hopefully, this time you can get 80 smiles or better. I know you can do it!
Ahh, and how are you all sleeping these days?
And what's a nice hot drink to have after skating?
Cocoa!
With marshmallows, right?
Let's get started then, shall we? Today's guest will be joining us for the third time now. She's the incredible singing sensation, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
And there it is, people! Haruka-chan's famous smile!
Come on now, Haruka-chan! A fan is trying to give you some encouragement! Don't you have any response for them?
Yeah, yeah. Shouldn't you be getting into the swing of things by now?
Okay! Today, let's delve a little bit into what it's really like to be an idol.
So, here's a question for you. You're very fit and slim, aren't you? What do you do to stay so slender?
I don't really do anything special. I get a lot of exercise with my daily dance lessons, so I don't seem to gain weight no matter how much I eat.
Well, aren't you lucky? Wish I could say the same. I'm starting to get a spare tire around the middle!
What do you think of people who are overweight, anyway?
Hehe. Looks like Haruka-chan is lost in thought.
Come on, girl! Pick up the pace!
For the sake of their health, I hope they can lose some weight.
Yeah, that's just what the doctors say, too. Eat less, exercise more, and lead a healthy life!
But even when we know we should, it's still hard to do.
Yes, but we all have to try, for our own sakes.
Yeah? If I lose some weight, would you give me some kind of a reward?
Um... No, I don't think so.
Ha! Good answer. Why should you, right?
I think they're cute. They look so soft and cuddly.
Hahaha, soft and cuddly is one way of putting it. Some people just come right out and say fat!
But if you think it's cute, then I don't feel so bad about gaining all this weight!
I think they probably aren't taking care of themselves as well as they should. Everyone has to be careful about that kind of thing.
You might be right, but when a skinny young thing like you says it, it gets people's hackles up, you know.
Uh-oh. Now you've done it. Half the audience isn't smiling anymore.
Now, let's see. This might be a generalization, but people tend to look up to idols. Many people even believe part of an idol's job should be to set a good example.
Idols who indulge in underage drinking or smoking take a real beating in the media.
Or they might even get severely criticized for doing something like crossing on a red light. Do you ever feel you're under too much scrutiny?
Well? What's your answer!?
Rules are rules for a reason. As responsible members of society, we should follow them. I never feel like I'm under too much scrutiny.
What a mature young lady you are! You're absolutely right.
Some people might bend the rules if they think nobody's looking, but we're always being judged from up high.
I was saying the same thing to our assistant director the other day, and then he goes and puts it out on social media that I gave him a big, long lecture!
I tell you, sometimes I feel like <Italic>I'm</Italic> under too much scrutiny!
To be honest, I do sometimes feel like I'm under too much scrutiny.
I guess that's the price you have to pay for being famous. So many people know your face now!
Yes. Sometimes I even notice people taking pictures of me with their cell phones.
Without even asking permission, right? Yeah, there sure are some rude people out there.
I don't really worry too much about all that. I mean, if no cars are coming, then go ahead and cross. I just leave it to common sense.
Yeah, but that thinking could get you in trouble.
You might not have run into this kind of thing yet, but nowadays any little thing you do can be blasted all over the internet, just like that!
Yeah! I mean, we're only human, right? Sometimes we feel tired or cranky.
I could just be having a bad day, and the next thing I know there are comments saying, "Nomu-san's such a cranky old man."
So, now that you've been on Osakan TV a few times, what you do think about all the people starting to recognize you?
Oh, I'm truly grateful. When I first came up here from Okinawa, I didn't know if I was going to make it. But now here I am, getting to do such wonderful work!
And I think you'll continue to get lots and lots of work, too!
So, what are your hopes for the future? Are you hoping to gain ground on the national stage?
Earth to Haruka-chan! Sheesh, even though this is the third time you've been on the show, we still don't click at all, do we?
That's what I'm shooting for! My entire agency has set that as their goal, actually.
Oh ho, that sounds like a lofty goal! I'll be cheering you on too!
Hey, when you go to Tokyo, will you let them know about a certain great TV show host you know from Osaka? Hehehe.
I want to always stay here in Osaka. The city has been so very kind and supportive.
But if you win the Princess League, aren't you supposed to have a national debut?
So doesn't that mean you'd be leaving Osaka?
Don't tell me you just realized this!
I actually already have my sights set on the international scene. I want to sing overseas, too.
Wait a minute! Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? That's kind of presumptuous of you!
But I guess they do say the world doesn't have any borders when it comes to music. Hey, so go ahead and set those sights high!
This time, if you get 80 smiles or more, I'll give you an exclusive Nomu-san cell phone strap!
I hope you all had fun! Please vote for me!
I had quite a bit of fun, myself!
Show me some love, everyone! Please vote for me!
If you love Haruka-chan, be sure to vote for her!
So this is your fourth time on the show, isn't it? I bet you're a seasoned pro by now.
Oh no, not at all. Nomu-san always has to help me along.
Nah, I think you're doing just fine.
What we're going to have you talk about today is what goes on behind the scenes of being an idol. Nomu-san really likes talking about that kind of thing.
We want you to try and get 85 smiles this time. So go out there and win everybody's hearts!
I'll do my best!
And what's that flightless bird that's gone extinct?
Dodo!
Hahaha, there we go! And now all is right in the world of "Love to See You Smile"!
Let's get started then, shall we? Today's guest will be joining us for the fourth time now. It's the adorable singing sensation, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
You're really getting good at this, aren't you? Adorable as ever, right, folks!?
Yeah, yeah. This is your fourth time on the show. Shouldn't you be used to this by now?
Okay! Today, I thought we could talk with Haruka-chan about some behind-the-scenes things in her life as an idol.
First off, what time do you start work? Or does it depend on the day?
When I don't already have work in the morning hours, I try to get to my agency at eight o'clock.
That's when I have my voice and dance lessons.
I bet an idol's lessons are pretty rough. What are your teachers like? Do you ever get mad at them for being too tough on you?
Haruka-chan is sure thinking over her answer.
Yes, I really get furious sometimes! Sometimes I wonder why they can't be just a little nicer.
Hehe, are you sure you want to say that on TV? They're going to see this, you know.
Oops! I guess you're right.
You'd better smooth things over now while you have the chance! Just say you were kidding.
Well, it's too late now.
No, I'm grateful to them. I wouldn't be where I am today if they weren't tough on me.
Uh-huh. I'm sure they're going to be watching this, right? You have to be polite.
But what do you really think? I promise I won't tell anybody!
No, I really mean it. I'm truly grateful to them.
No. It's just business, after all. As professionals, we're all just doing what we need to do.
Strictly business, huh? That seems kind of impersonal, if you ask me.
Oh, it's not like that at all.
Hmm. As a matter of fact, I feel a wall between us right now. I bet if this wasn't for work, you wouldn't give me the time of day, would you?
So, do you ever do any kind of fan appreciation, like autograph or handshake events? What's it like to meet the fans up close like that?
Although, I guess your fans are nearby right now, aren't they?
Would you look at that! She responds to her fans like a real pro!
